Current main still runs workspace journal storage on the Gateway thread, and this PR provides a substantive worker migration. The reported real-Gateway setup run supports integration but does not cover a v2026.9.7 pending journal entering candidate startup. No stored journal format or schema change was identified, so data-model compatibility is not applicable; the release upgrade recovery gap remains a separate merge risk. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Verification | Check | Result | Evidence | |---|---|---| | **Real behavior** | Verified | Sufficient (terminal): The changed journal owner is exercised through the production SQLite worker broker with injected reply corruption and observed retained-journal recovery; editor tests also check the final database effect after revocation and session reassignment. The reported real-Gateway setup run supports integration but does not cover a v2026.9.7 pending journal entering candidate startup. No stored journal format or schema change was identified, so data-model compatibility is not applicable; the release upgrade recovery gap remains a separate merge risk. | | **Evidence reviewed** | 9 items | Current main still uses synchronous journal storage: The registered placement store on current main uses the synchronous journal operations; the PR substitutes worker operations at the same registration point.
Worker journal registration: The PR registers the worker-backed journal operations in the placement store.
Live admission and commit receipt: The worker handoff checks caller authority at admission, validates commit receipts, and uses a committed receipt after ordinary reply loss. | | **Findings** | None | None. | | **Security** | None | None. | ## How this fits together The Gateway uses a durable journal while applying cloud worker changes to a local workspace. Confirm migration or upgrade compatibility proof before merge. ### Merge-risk options **Maintainer options:** 1. **Prove released-journal recovery (recommended)** Start the candidate Gateway with a pending v2026.9.7 journal and verify restored file bytes, preserved owner checks, and journal cleanup. ### Technical review Best possible solution: Keep the shared workers as the journal storage owner and qualify restart recovery with a pending journal produced by v2026.9.7 before landing. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Not applicable as a refactor request. Current-main source establishes the synchronous journal path, while the PR's production broker tests exercise the proposed replacement. Is this the best way to solve the issue? Yes, the existing shared-state workers are the appropriate storage owner. The remaining release-to-candidate recovery case must be verified before merge. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. No stored journal format or schema change was identified, so data-model compatibility is not applicable; the release upgrade recovery gap remains a separate merge risk. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Current main still uses synchronous journal storage:** The registered placement store on current main uses the synchronous journal operations; the PR substitutes worker operations at the same registration point. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-store.ts:141`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6/src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-store.ts#L141), [daf740e6a77f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6)) - **Live admission and commit receipt:** The worker handoff checks caller authority at admission, validates commit receipts, and uses a committed receipt after ordinary reply loss. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-workspace-journal-store.ts:90`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6/src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-workspace-journal-store.ts#L90), [daf740e6a77f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6)) - **Final worker transaction:** Journal mutation runs in the shared-state write transaction and requests admission again before its commit receipt. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-workspace-journal.worker.ts:39`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6/src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-workspace-journal.worker.ts#L39), [daf740e6a77f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6)) - **Recovery and forbidden-authority coverage:** Production broker tests inspect a corrupted worker reply, reject a revoked caller before a journal write, and check that a queued editor manifest cannot commit after its session binding changes. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/workspace-result-repository.editor-admission.test.ts:129`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6/src/gateway/worker-environments/workspace-result-repository.editor-admission.test.ts#L129), [daf740e6a77f](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/daf740e6a77f6da7e2b4b5c020849163adfe4bb6)) - **Published journal format:** The v2026.9.7 journal has version 1 and stores plan_json and base_pack. The PR changes their access path; the inspected source does not show a stored-format change. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-workspace-journal.ts:187`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c074824a27c96d3983043f9eeb33823cd1772d8c/src/gateway/worker-environments/placement-workspace-journal.ts#L187), [c074824a27c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c074824a27c96d3983043f9eeb33823cd1772d8c)) Likely related people: - **Peter Steinberger:** Suggested for follow-up; no historical authorship or introduction is verified. (role: unverified routing candidate; confidence: low) ### Rank-up moves Optional improvements that raise the rating; they are not merge blockers. - Show a v2026.9.7 pending journal surviving restart into the candidate Gateway, including restored workspace bytes and journal cleanup. ### Rating scale | Score | Internal tier | Crab rank | Meaning | |---:|:---:|---|---| | **6/6** | S | 🦀 challenger crab | Exceptional readiness | | **5/6** | A | 🦞 diamond lobster | Very strong readiness | | **4/6** | B | 🐚 platinum hermit | Good normal PR; ordinary maintainer review | | **3/6** | C | 🦐 gold shrimp | Useful, but confidence is limited | | **2/6** | D | 🦪 silver shellfish | Proof or implementation needs work | | **1/6** | F | 🧂 unranked krab | Not merge-ready | | N/A | NA | 🌊 off-meta tidepool | Rating does not apply | Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality. Shiny media proof means a screenshot, video, or linked artifact directly shows the changed behavior.
